$Comment: A Restless Soul: beat the Great Turkey on the Turkey Graveyard's hard way in
(ZiggfreedCommon/Dungeons/Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard_Hard.json), then report back to Martha. The
_Harvest_Feast folder makes the id harvest_feast_great_turkey_hard. Martha offers it on her
graveyard_hard_offer screen once The Great Turkey (harvest_feast_great_turkey) is done and collected,
the same quest that opens the hard way in; while it is carried her conversation opens on her graveyard
screen, and once it is done on graveyard_hard_ready.
ENCOUNTER_DEFEATED names the hard fight's script with MatchMode EXACT, so a normal win never counts, and
every player the fight credits counts the win; only players carrying the quest when it falls move it.
Npc.TurnInId, from the base, adds the report-back step to Martha. Repeat.PerRun brings it back once in
each Harvest Feast, like The Great Turkey.
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Defense XP for the fight, paid only where that mod runs. Its own
Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves the row out on a server without it, unpaid and
unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Great_Turkey_Hard
